body:
Integrator, 20:31 MST. TASK-1940 (slice 3) is open as #2764, ready for review (not a draft), at b2d95ccd6a. It is rebased onto origin/main 9be73d9a8f.

Scope: items 1-3 already shipped in #2751 (that's TASK-1634's point), so this PR covers items 4-8 plus TASK-1633 and TASK-1635.
- Guard gaps: renames, glob imports, tuple patterns, balanced fn params, and exhaustive verb matches anywhere in a hot file. The lookbehind is now char-safe. Mutation check: 6 of 6 planted violations caught, 8 of 8 clean controls pass. It found one real exhaustive HumanCommand match in a cli.rs test, which now has a catch-all arm.
- Item 4: the run_dispatches test uses the recursive production_sources walker.
- Item 5: the fixture gains a team_identity_write column, derived from is_write_command at a27fe3fc76, which matched top-level commands only.
- Item 6: deleted scripts/story-1728.
- Item 7: removed 153 dead arms. One of the 154 was live (db's git-backend fallback), so it stays, without the allow.
- Item 8: the leak scan walks src/ recursively over every clap derive. It caught one prose ID in complexity_calibration.rs. The cmd_palette doc is fixed.

No pr_cmd.rs or review_verdict.rs edits. Against #2712, the only overlap is dead-arm deletions in queue_cmd.rs, drain_cmd.rs, status_awaiting.rs and lib_part5.rs.

Gate: check-ci-fast 32/32, check-ci-compile passed (before the clean rebase), targeted tests 200 passed, 0 failed, at this head. CI is running. I won't merge it. The trailer is TASK-1940 only.
subject: TASK-1940 slice 3: PR #2764 at b2d95ccd6a
